counts_note: 15,592 completed hikes against 492 reviews is 32 hikes per review, where the rest of this set runs between one and four. Noted, not treated as a fault: marking a hike complete is one tap in the AllTrails app and writing a review is not, so a wide ratio is what an app-logged trail looks like. Kept in the correlation. Worth revisiting only if hikes-per-review turns out to track something we care about.
description_note: AllTrails describes the waterfall correctly -- six tiers dropping like a stone staircase, which is what it is -- while placing it on the Oconaluftee in the Smokies. It is on the Horsepasture in Gorges State Park, which the same record's park and location fields get right. So the prose is worth reading for what the falls IS and not for where it is.
